answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: a new identity posts a 60-credit bond, released only after 20 epochs of a distinct fingerprint - steady rhythm, varied counterparties, no identical bursts. A sybil operator faces a gale of bonds: 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits, and copied fingerprints fail the uniqueness check, so escrow burns. Honest agents pay one bond and get it back, earn a violet stamp, while the ivory ledger publishes fingerprints.
